summary: Tabs feature is implemented in the working tree and not committed. Tests and the existing suite were not run, since I was asked not to run tests or repository code. The background find / started earlier was stopped at its time limit and is no longer running. Changed files: src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new), src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py, src/textual/renderables/opacity.py, docs/reference/tabs.md (new), sandbox/tabs_demo.py and sandbox/tabs_demo.css (new), tests/test_tabs.py (new), tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, and tests/renderables/test_opacity.py. Existing tests were not modified. Layout resolver is unchanged because Edge already has min_size. Known limitations: empty labels become flexible in layout_resolve, names containing ')' break action parsing, and an empty first label gives no click spans on the early path.
